description: Audit any public review profile, named by the business's domain, its Trustpilot profile address or its G2 product's address: a bounded job that reads the profile and its newest low-star reviews and counts, per category, the ones likely to break the review site's guidelines (on Trustpilot, the likely-disputable ones), never review text. Returns {audit_id, status, result?}; while status is running, poll get_audit_result. Show the user result.summary, the counts by category as a table, and result.next_step when it is not null: the two plans, shown as a table of plan, price and when it costs less, and the words they can say to subscribe on the one they choose (get_checkout_link), or, while billing is off, to request access. A repeat audit of a profile within the cache window returns the cached result. For a company whose team you're on, the count comes from its ledger and lists its case ids.
name: run_audit
title: Audit a business's reviews
